name: IEEE 4 Node Test Feeder, Y-D step-down, unbalanced
description: IEEE PES Distribution System Analysis Subcommittee, IEEE 4 Node Test Feeder (W. H. Kersting), published case Y-D (ungrounded wye - delta) step-down, unbalanced load, 1275 kW at 0.85 pf (a-b), 1800 kW at 0.9 pf (b-c) and 2375 kW at 0.95 pf (c-a), all lagging, the load DELTA connected (the secondary is a three-wire system). Infinite 12.47 kV source at node 1; four-wire line 1-2 (2000 ft) and three-wire line 3-4 (2500 ft); 6000 kVA 12.47/4.16 kV ungrounded-wye / delta transformer 2-3 (ANSI: the higher-voltage side leads by 30 degrees) with Z = 1.0 + j6.0 % (equal winding impedances); delta constant-power load at node 4. Line codes as in the D-GrY files (published geometry, Kersting's modified Carson equations; the four-wire code Kron-reduced, the three-wire code without a neutral). Published node voltages: tests/GridSim.Tests/Dist3phDeltaSecondaryTransformerTests.cs (also tabulated in the LBL Modelica Buildings library, IEEETests.Test4NodesFeeder).
